_comment: GATE-3D free baselines per AMENDMENT A2 (reports/2026-07-04-vizdoom-3d-floor-design.md SS A2.1-A2.3): the four pre-registered perception-free policies, 200 episodes each, dtc_gate.cfg, tics=4 fixed, 1000-tic/250-step budget, fresh seed blocks (30000/31000/32000/33000 + 200 each) distinct from the 30 pinned gate seeds (1000-1029), from each other, and from the superseded A2-trigger run's blocks (20000-22199). Measured by tools/gate3d_baselines.py in the vizdoom-world Docker image, 2026-07-03 (the A2.3 re-run). This file is the scorer's ONLY source for D and KPS_spinner (eval/score_gate3d.py: D = max mean_killcount over all policy entries; KPS_spinner = the strongest-K spinner* entry's kps). Pre-registered law -- edited only by a reviewed, explicit commit; the D set is ADD-ONLY per SS A2.2.
_arm_a2_bar_formula: KPS_brain >= 1.5 * KPS_spinner (strongest-K spinner variant); >= 10 total brain shots else INSUFFICIENT_DATA

_derived_at_this_measurement.note: informational only -- the scorer re-derives D/KPS_spinner from the policy entries above, so an add-only D-set extension needs no edit here

_decoy_clears_arm_a1_bar.note: by construction NONE can clear it: every measured decoy is <= D = 4.11 < max(D+1.5, 1.15*D) = 5.61 (SS A2.2's structural replacement of the A1.4 decoy guard). Stated explicitly per the A2 fix-round brief.

_a2_trigger_record: the superseded 2026-07-03 pre-A2 measurement (R=1.375, alternating spinner 3.66 >= A1.4 bar 3.375, ATTACK-only 1.47 under) stays on the books as the A2 trigger record in reports/2026-07-04-vizdoom-3d-floor-design.md SS A2 and PR #75's history; per SS A2.3 it is superseded as a scorer input by this re-run.
_multihot_note: spinner_multihot is A1.4's literal decoy (TURN_LEFT + ATTACK on the same tic, every step), measured via the SS A2.1-sanctioned raw-vizdoom path in tools/gate3d_baselines.py. spinner_alternating is PR #75's original weakened stand-in, retained per SS A2.1 as a second data point.
